newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA SAYS TO SPEED UP AIR CARGO CLEARANCE.
newsitem.headline: INDIA SAYS TO SPEED UP AIR CARGO CLEARANCE.

text.p: The Indian government has decided to take immediate steps to facilitate clearance of export air cargo in 12 hours and import cargo within a maximum 24 hours, a government statement said on Friday.

The Departments of Revenue and Coordination will coordinate the clearance work. This was decided at the first meeting of the Export Promotion Board, chaired by the highest- ranking civil servant, T.S.R. Subramanium.
Senior officials of Commerce, Civil Aviation, Industry, Textile and Finance Ministries' attended the meeting.
The statement said that, in view of the hardening of the rupee, the Board underlined the need to make a detailed study of the way the export sector was currently being financed.
"It was also emphasised that credit flow for the export sector should be such that it did not pose a problem for the exporting community," the statement said.
The Board members also agreed that "systematic changes" was needed to ensure better coordination among infrastructure agencies to accelerate the country's export growth rate, the statement said.
